skip.source_cn: 你向佐尔娅讲述了来龙去脉，她则建议你将苔佩希送入家族地宫休养。必要时刻，她也可以通过魔法师协会的秘术来到诺珐斯，协助你治疗苔佩希。

en.text: After hearing your account, Zorya advises moving Tephesia to the family crypt to recover. If necessary, she can use the Arcane Council's secret arts to reach Novaris and help with the treatment.
